scope: Synthetic generic primitive cost only. Own optimized word64/128 reference, not former2 or current champion. Full means prepare/drop each call with repeated resident raw inputs; prepared retains caches. Includes barrier/result observer.

actual_caller_audit.scope: Actual selected C/static closure and ASM backedge proof of repeated external barrier+fixed adapter. No assertion of kernel speed, zero allocations, or algorithm correctness.

native_oracle.scope: Finite native checks only, not an all-input proof.

paired.scope: All retained synthetic timed cases; not a competition/model score or success probability.
